narr: A slow moving warm front brought multiple rounds of strong to severe thunderstorms and heavy rainfall from late morning on June 3rd into the early morning hours of June 4th. Areas of flooding did occur along with some wind damage.
ev: Flowing water from open fields and residential yards across portions of Lake Drive and into Lake Koshkonong. Flooding basements reported.

Flowing water over small portions of rural roads due to flooding of farm fields or ditches. This included high water over a portion of highway A between Footville and Janesville, and several inches of water on Townline Road near Avon. A roof collapsed in Edgerton due to the accumulation and weight of rain water. Urban street flooding also prevalent.
